We are looking for an Automotive Test & Validation Engineer to join an international engineering project for a leading global automotive manufacturer.
The role focuses on vehicle testing, test-bench support, software validation, and Over-the-Air (OTA) activities, contributing to the successful integration and validation of automotive electronic systems.
 Key Responsibilities
Provide technical support for test-bench activities and vehicle testing operations.
Perform vehicle testing activities, including IBN (commissioning) and PGN-related processes.
Support Over-the-Air (OTA) software updates and validation activities.
Participate in on-site ECU flashing campaigns and software integration activities.
Analyze test results, identify technical issues, and support troubleshooting processes.
Collaborate with international engineering teams to ensure effective testing and validation.
Prepare technical documentation, test reports, and validation results.
Participate in monthly on-site assignments in Győr (Hungary) or Ingolstadt (Germany), depending on project requirements.
 Working Conditions
Salary: 8,500–10,000 RON net/month.
Working model: Predominantly remote, with monthly business trips to Győr or Ingolstadt.
Project: International automotive engineering environment, supporting a leading global automotive manufacturer.
 Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Automotive Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Previous hands-on experience in automotive testing, vehicle validation, software integration, or similar engineering activities.
Good understanding of automotive electronic systems, ECUs, and vehicle communication networks.
Familiarity with test-bench operations, testing procedures, and validation processes.
Knowledge of automotive diagnostics, troubleshooting, and software flashing activities.
Understanding of Over-the-Air (OTA) software update processes.
Ability to analyze technical issues, interpret test results, and prepare technical documentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a hands-on approach.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Availability for monthly business trips to Győr (Hungary) or Ingolstadt (Germany).
Ability to work independently and collaborate with international engineering teams.
 Nice To Have
Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
Familiarity with diagnostic and testing tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, ODIS, or similar.
Previous experience with ECU flashing, vehicle commissioning, or OTA validation.
Knowledge of automotive software integration and validation processes.
German language skills.
Experience working on international automotive projects.
 SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.
